summary: Phase 4 audit, report only (no app code changed). Covered everything except the mock-test player, at 390x844, with key screens at 320x640 and 820x1180. All requested design changes are in place: home-promo is gone, and home-dream sits between For you and Explore JEELIVE (y 1098 -> 1244 -> 1597). The Dream College Meter has a purple header band, a light sweep, a purple border and glow, and a deep black body. Dream rows go royal blue, teal, royal blue, teal (checked from the CSS gradients). Every row has its diamond 9px from the right edge and 7px from the bottom. The Rank tab shows 6 tiles in 3 rows of 2. rank-tool-dream shows dream-panel below the tiles. The exam switch labels ('JEE Main 3/5', 'BITSAT 2/5'), the count, the tile value ('5 dream chune' then '4 dream chune') and Home all update after a remove. home-dream-more opens Rank with the Dream tile selected and the panel visible. home-dream-add and home-dream-add-more open the College predictor. Every Home tile, chip, For you entry and the account button goes to the right place. Rank tools that work: rp (JEE and COMEDK, rp-share, rp-colleges handover), pr (pr-colleges goes to the JEE list), tm (JEE, BITSAT and COMEDK, college search sheet, tm-pdf downloads), College predictor (JEE list in 0.6 s, CollegeSheet opens, BITSAT list, star toggle, rank-pdf downloads), cmp (empty state). Each pane keeps its result when you switch tiles or exams. Rapid Fire: the lobby loads in 0.5 s and the scope sheet opens. One Practice Rival match was played to the end (VICTORY 12-11, result screen OK). Trophy, Gang, Store and the player profile all open. Mission: all 5 testIDs are present and share-top/bottom open api.whatsapp.com. My Tests: 3 tabs and the chips work, and a completed result opens in 0.8 s. Account, Change PIN (opened, not submitted), privacy, sign out and sign back in all work. /pyq, both catalogue routes, /live and /performance render. No red screens and no JS errors, apart from the expected 401 on /auth/refresh before login. Main new issue: the jeelive.ai upstream rate limit (429) logs the user out on a page reload and blocks sign-in. No deprecated Expo packages, and no SafeAreaView is imported from react-native.

critical.issue: jeelive.ai returned 429 on /auth/session after only about 7 calls in 5 minutes (backend.err.log 22:24:46 and 22:24:50). Sign-in returned 'Too many attempts. Please wait 140s' after about 9 logins in 13 minutes from one tester. The proxy does not pass on the client IP (X-Forwarded-For) or any other per-user signal, so every app user may share the server's single IP for jeelive.ai's limits. At launch traffic this could block sign-in and session checks for everyone. We could not confirm whether the limit is per IP or per phone, so check with jeelive.ai.

ui_bugs.issue: Any session-check error other than 401 (here 429) shows 'Couldn't check your session. Connect to the internet and retry, or sign in below.' and leaves the user on /entry. A full reload of /rapid/squads after the 429 landed on the sign-in screen even though the session was valid. The message wrongly blames the internet. There is no automatic retry with backoff and no use of the cached user.

Mock history comes only from result pages opened on this device (dream.v1.mocks). After a fresh login with 20 completed results, Home still says 'Pehla full JEE Main mock do'. Opening the older result 4ff8dce7 (5/300) made it 'LAST MOCK', but the newer JEE Main PYQ attempt (-2/300) is never counted. The gaps shown are therefore against the wrong or a missing score. Suggest building mocks from /my/tests?tab=completed.

Home uses the exam of the last mock, otherwise the first exam that has dreams. With 2 JEE and 2 BITSAT dreams, Home showed only 'JEE Main 2/5', and there is no 'Sab N dream dekho' link until one exam has more than 3 dreams. BITSAT dreams cannot be reached from Home. If the last mock is BITSAT and the dreams are JEE only, Home shows an empty card. Suggest a link or exam switch whenever the total number of dreams is more than the number shown.
Opens /catalogue?slug=jee-main&kind=chapters, which shows '0 LIVE CHAPTER TESTS' in every subject. BITSAT chapters has 61 tests. A main Home shortcut leads to an empty screen.
'DREAM COLLEGE METER · JEE MAIN' is cut to 'DREAM COLLEGE METER …' (numberOfLines=1), so the exam name, the key information, is hidden on small phones.
rank-seat-N-cta 'Cutoff dekho' is 121x38, under the 44px minimum. This is the main action on every college card.
In 1 of about 10 logins, tapping Sign in right after typing (no delay) did nothing and showed no error or spinner. It worked after a 1.5 s wait.
The duel route params contain an encoded picks value with 'null' ('...null}]'), so encodePicks is serialising an empty field. Harmless today, but it makes the URL longer and could break deep links.

issues: When narrow, the value line gets paddingRight 0, so 'colleges + cutoffs' and 'marks se rank' run under the corner diamond and end in an ellipsis. Titles and NEW badges are fine, with no badge-on-title overlap.
The copy repeats itself: 'Har mock ke baad yahan dikhega … kitne marks door' appears twice in the same card (the nomock line and the empty line).
Home and Rank have no maxWidth (Rapid Fire uses 560), so cards stretch to 788px. The Practice tiles are very tall with a lot of empty space, and the dream rows and tiles look sparse.
Sign out acts at once with no confirmation. One accidental tap ends the session, and with the 429 limits above, signing back in can then be blocked for minutes.
The 'Sab 4 dream dekho' and '1 aur dream jodo' links are stacked with a large gap between them and look disconnected.

action_items: HIGH: Handle 429 and 5xx from /auth/session as temporary errors in src/auth.tsx: keep the cached user, retry with backoff using Retry-After, and show a 'busy, retrying' message instead of 'connect to the internet' and the sign-in screen.

HIGH: Check jeelive.ai's rate-limit key. If the limit is per IP, pass the client IP (rightmost X-Forwarded-For, as pin_reset.py already does) in forward_jeelive (server.py:140), or ask for a server allowlist, so all users do not share one server IP. Also cut repeated /auth/session calls (one per full load today).
MEDIUM: Build the Dream meter's mock history from the server's completed results (/my/tests?tab=completed), not only from result pages opened on this device.
MEDIUM: HomeDream: show a link or switch for the other exams' dreams, and show 'Sab N dream dekho' whenever the total number of dreams is more than the number shown.
MEDIUM: Hide the 'chapter-wise' Explore chip, or point it to an exam that has chapter tests, while JEE Main chapters is empty.

LOW: At width under 360, wrap or shorten the Dream header so the exam name shows. Keep tile values clear of the corner diamond. Raise rank-seat-N-cta to at least 44px tall. Remove the repeated empty-state copy.
LOW: Add a maxWidth container for Home and Rank on tablets. Add a sign-out confirmation. Drop null fields in encodePicks. Make sure the Sign in button gives feedback on every tap.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.tsx:58 treats every non-401 error as offline. Only network errors should get that message; 429 and 5xx need retry with backoff.
server.py forward_jeelive does not pass on any client identity, even though pin_reset.py and mission_links.py already read X-Forwarded-For.
HomeDream.tsx: exam selection is tied to s.mocks[0], which only fills when a result page is opened on this device.
ToolGrid.tsx:51: the narrow layout removes the right padding that protects the value line from the diamond, which contradicts the comment above it.
updated_files: /app/tests/phase4_rest_of_app_ui.py (new reference test script only; no app code changed)

success_rate.frontend: about 88% of checked flows pass; 3 HIGH (rate limit / session), 3 MEDIUM, several LOW

seed_data_creation: No server seed data. Dreams were pinned and removed only in each fresh browser context's localStorage (dream.v1). One allowed Rapid Fire Practice Rival match was played (VICTORY 12-11, 1 Red and 1 Blue diamond earned for the QA player). The shortlist star on rank-seat-0 was toggled on and off again (back to its original state). Opening result 4ff8dce7 only wrote local dream.v1.mocks. No academic attempt was started. No PIN change and no account creation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: jeelive.ai rate-limits sign-in (about 9 logins in 13 min gave 'wait 140s') and /auth/session (429 after about 7 calls in 5 min). Use few logins per run, move between screens with SPA clicks or history.pushState instead of page.goto, and sleep about 3 min if you hit 429. Wait 1.5 s after the entry screen loads before typing. The Home tab stays mounted (hidden) under other tabs, so use :visible selectors such as [data-testid$=-dream]. College predictor dream buttons are rank-seat-N-dream (JEE) and bitsat-item-N-dream. Target marks college search: tm-college opens tm-college-sheet with tm-college-sheet-search and rows tm-college-sheet-<n>. Duel options are [data-testid^=duel-option-]:not([data-testid*=text]) and the result is duel-result/duel-outcome. A Practice Rival match takes about 60 s.
rca_of_issue: Logout on reload: the page reloads, checkSession calls /api/jl/auth/session, and the proxy calls jeelive.ai from the server IP. jeelive.ai answers 429, the proxy passes 429 back, and auth.tsx:58 sets sessionError and ready=true with no user, so the router shows /entry. Repro: do about 8 or more full reloads or logins within 5 minutes, then reload any deep route.
